score.description: Final plan score per the rubric: 10.0 minus the sum of deductions, one decimal place

verdict.description: pass if there is NO finding with severity critical or high, otherwise fail. The score does NOT affect the verdict: a plan with score 6.5 and only medium/low findings is a pass

summary.description: 2-4 sentences in English: the main thing the critic thinks about the plan

deductions.description: Breakdown of the score. Empty array only when score = 10.0

weight.description: Positive number: how many points were deducted for this item, the weight from the rubric

reason.description: What exactly was deducted for, in English, concretely

findings.description: Findings on the plan. Each must be an action, not an observation

id.description: Short identifier like C1, C2, C3, so a finding can be referenced in the reply

severity.description: Defect class strictly per the rubric weight table: critical = breaks production or loses data / hole in isolation or permissions; high = a critical project rule is violated, plan logic defect, unverified assumption about an external system on which access control or the data source depends; medium = load without an estimate, coverage gap, other unverified assumptions; low = incomplete description and cosmetics. critical and high BLOCK the plan: assigning them without a concrete failure scenario in failure_scenario is forbidden, such a finding is downgraded to medium

title.description: One line in English: the gist of the finding

detail.description: Why this is a problem and what will happen if left as is. A concrete failure scenario, not generalities

failure_scenario.description: Under which inputs or state what exactly breaks: concrete, in English. Required for critical and high: without it the finding counts as an observation and is downgraded to medium. For medium and low the string '—' is acceptable

evidence.description: The finding's anchor in the REPOSITORY as path:line (for example src/billing/cache.ts:87): what exactly in the code confirms the defect. If the finding concerns the plan text and there is no anchor in code, write 'plan only' and explain in detail why code is not enough. A critical/high finding without a code anchor or without an explanation of why there is none is weakened and must be downgraded

plan_section.description: Which step or section of the plan it refers to. '—' if the whole plan

suggested_fix.description: What exactly to change in the plan. This is an edit to the PLAN, not to code
